name: workday-live-po-line-status
summary: On-open TxScript hook refreshing each matched PO line's live received/invoiced consumption from the Workday procurement REST API — quantities for goods lines, amounts for service lines.

goods_order_type_id.description: order-type id marking goods lines (quantity consumption)

service_order_type_id.description: order-type id marking service lines (amount consumption)

provenance: Harvested 2026-07-03 from one production Workday AP implementation (refined: per-run PO cache added — the source refetched the same PO once per line — and the OAuth call corrected to POST); demanded verbatim by an upcoming Workday AP SOW (live status verification on annotation open). Single-source — treat with extra suspicion.
notes: REST, not SOAP, on purpose: the SOAP Get_Purchase_Orders sync does not expose per-line received/invoiced consumption, so master data is always stale for GRN/over-invoicing checks (this is the documented live-consumption workaround; the connector itself never does this). Hook code grammar: txscript-reference#serverless-hooks. Hook events: annotation_content.initialize/started/updated, run_after the PO-matching hook, sideload schemas, token_owner set (the hook PATCHes its own secrets to cache the bearer), org must allow external HTTPS egress. Secrets: client_id, client_secret, refresh_token (bearer_token is written back by the hook — so secrets_schema must be the OPEN string-map shape, not additionalProperties: false). The REST path segment is the PO's Workday internal id (WID), NOT the PO document number — project it onto lines during PO header matching. Line lookup parses the line number from the trailing token of the REST line 'descriptor' (no bare line-number field observed) — fragile; verify per tenant/API version, as is the bare-vs-{value:...}-wrapped numeric shape. CANDIDATE: single-source; validate on a second tenant before promoting.
